note: Effects on the After Effects Effect menu, by category, with the match names published in the scripting guide (null where none is published: the effect is found by display name in app.effects at run time) and the controls the help pages list. From adobe-capability-atlas; regenerate with scripts/update-effects.js.

controls.name: Set Frame
controls.reason: A button in the Effect Controls panel that samples the current frame; scripts cannot press it.

controls.name: The
controls.reason: Not a control: a fragment of the help text. The curves themselves are a custom-data property that scripts cannot read or set.

controls.name: Histogram
controls.reason: The histogram is a display in the Effect Controls panel, not a value.

controls.name: Distortion Mesh
controls.reason: The mesh is custom data edited by dragging in the Composition panel; scripts cannot set it.

controls.name: Correspondence Pairs
controls.reason: Correspondence points are placed on the masks interactively in the Composition panel; no property holds them.
